body_lead: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: The Kerala State Transport Minister, Antony Raju, has issued directives to accelerate the speed at which penalty challans are sent for violations detected by Artificial Intelligence (AI) cameras. The minister proposed that the entire process should be completed within three months. During a recent review meeting, it was decided to include details of vehicles registered in other states of Kerala as well. Minister Raju highlighted that the implementation of AI cameras in the state has resulted in a reduction in traffic violations.
